information:
Welcome to Alexandria Big And Blind 2026!
This competition will include all the blindfolded events, FMC, 6x6 and 7x7 as well as a round of 3x3 and a round of 2x2 in the morning.
Please read all the tabs before registering so you can know what to expect at this competition.
